task_info.original_instruction:
I received an important email from Sarah Kim at NexGen Analytics regarding their software evaluation.

Please:
1. Check my inbox for the email from Sarah Kim (sarah.kim@nexgenanalytics.com)
2. Find or create the contact "Sarah Kim" at "NexGen Analytics" in the CRM
3. Create a note in the CRM linked to this contact summarizing the email content
4. Send a reply to Sarah confirming we'll schedule a demo, and include the exact phrase "demo scheduled"

tool_params.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your software evaluation at NexGen Analytics.

I've reviewed your requirements for real-time data processing, AWS integration, and SOC2 compliance. We'd be happy to schedule a demo to show you how our platform can meet your team's needs.

I'll coordinate with our team to find a suitable time next week. The demo scheduled for your 25-engineer team will cover all the features you mentioned, and we can discuss how our solution fits within your $50,000-75,000 budget range.

I'll follow up shortly with some time options. Please let me know if there's a specific day or time that works best for you.

Best regards,
CRM Team
